requiredRepair: When a prior method is declared successful, preserve a compact structural fingerprint of the method rather than only a slogan or one salient dimension.
Before claiming to reuse or test the same method, compare the current execution plan against the fingerprint. Missing defining dimensions means it is a method variant, not the same-method test.

For the current humanization lane, the fingerprint is: literal current sentence/span -> explicit operation -> concrete positive generation target; freeze instructions before generation; when testing phase separation, apply them on a later turn without rewriting them; preserve meaning; then cold-audit the complete result and expose strongest attacks/rejected alternatives before detector submission.

Keep method factors separable in experiment interpretation. Turn separation, instruction granularity, positive-vs-negative guidance, preservation gating, and post-generation audit are different variables and must not be collapsed into one label such as 'instruction-first method'.
At task-time activation, prefer the closest successful literal workflow artifact over an older available guide that only approximately matches the method name.
